Description: A ring given by a sea captain lost during the events of the All Flags Navy to their heart-broken beloved.

A salt-stained blade from High Isle, most likely used to defend the lives of a beloved flock.

A rough, heavy mining tool, turned into a weapon by hostile druids on Amenos.
Ancient armor, smelling faintly of rot, found abandoned in the graveyard at Death's Valor Keep.

A blade that has been in Ilyes Maul's family for a long time. It was probably used by the ancient pirates of Ghost Haven Bay.

A bag containing a small collection of useful elixirs and potions.

A gore-stained mace found on the grounds of the Spire of the Crimson Coin.

Sturdy leather armor crafted by the Stonelore Druids as a gift from a grateful circle.
Worn but well-crafted armor taken from a fallen jailer at Whalefall.
